title: Humayun's Tomb, Delhi
summary: Humayun's Tomb in Delhi is a Mughal mausoleum begun in 1565 and finished in 1572, nine years after the emperor died. It is built of red sandstone with a white marble double dome, on a terraced platform. India's tourism ministry gives its height as 47 m and its breadth as 91 m.

uncertainty.note: 1565-1572 is the construction span given by both the Ministry of Tourism page and The Daily Star. End is the present.

reviewer_note: Shape domed_building. The 47 m height and 91 m breadth are from one page and may include the platform; The Daily Star gives only the dome (42.5 m high) and a platform 6.5 m high and 99 m wide, which the 91 m breadth does not match, so the plan is the least certain number. The patron is disputed (Haji Begam vs Akbar) and the record names neither. UNESCO's own page was not readable.
